# Meu pacote do MiniInfos\n\nEste arquiv:
# My MiniInfos package

This .miniinfos file is a ZIP. Make a copy, rename it to .zip and extract it.
Edit manifest.json: use your own ID (author.name), name, author, version and license.
UNLICENSED is only a template placeholder: choose a license before sharing.
Keep schemaVersion 1 and manifest.json at the root when creating the ZIP again.
To test, use Add theme or Add mascot in MiniInfos settings.
Manifest property names are the package contract; unknown fields are rejected.
\nAs cores ficam em theme.colors, no for:
Colors go in theme.colors, using #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.
The base theme can be Simple, Light or Classic. headerImage is an optional PNG.
\nsprites.png é uma grade de células igu:
sprites.png is a grid of equal-sized cells with a transparent background.
mascot.columns and mascot.rows describe the grid; states maps each animation to a row.
Idle is required. Frames and durationsMs let you choose frames and their durations.
Anatomy uses coordinates from 0 to 320, regardless of the image size.
Adjust clickable regions, pose points and mass centers for your character.
MiniInfos provides the drag and rotation physics.
